disposition_reason: Prints mean, SD and range of 28 elements, including lead, cadmium, arsenic, nickel, chromium and aluminium, in durum wheat whole seed, bran, semolina and flour from organic and conventional plots.

study.design: field experiment: 20 durum wheat varieties on adjacent organic and conventional plots, harvested seed milled into bran, semolina and flour
study.origin: AMAP experimental fields, Jesi, Marche, Italy (clay soils)
study.method: ICP-OES (iCAP PRO X Duo) after microwave digestion with HNO3/HCl of about 1 g dried sample
study.lod_text: LOD and LOQ computed from calibration lines by instrument software; numeric values only in supplementary Table S1 (not in the PDF)
study.qa: five-point calibration 0.001 to 10 mg/L with multi-element standards; no certified reference material or recovery reported
